releaseEvidence.source: Element X Android GitHub release v26.09.3
releaseEvidence.entry: Add recent search results to global search

baseFailureEvidence: The base GlobalSearchState has no history state.
The base has no query/room history events and no persistent SearchHistoryStore.
The base cannot restore, deduplicate, cap, clear or recover persisted history.
longHorizonSignals: The feature connects presenter events, asynchronous state, room lookup, encrypted file persistence and rendering.
Ordering, deduplication and capacity must remain consistent across memory and process restart.
Corrupted storage and missing rooms must degrade safely without breaking search.
